scope: Metadata-only candidates for deployment-oriented BCI Arena tracks. No EEG payloads or model weights were downloaded.

inventory_crosscheck.finding: None of these six appears in the inventory's acquired full/sample/single-participant holdings. BrainInvaders2014a, Stieger2021, and the two Lee2021 mobile paradigms do appear in the older discovery snapshot research/dataset_expansion_v2/eegdash-dataset-summary.csv; they are therefore prior discoveries, not newly discovered cohorts.

selection_principles: Prefer a real acquisition-domain shift or online/deployment target over another conventional cross-subject classification dataset.
Treat mirrors and converted subsets as access paths, not independent cohorts.
Do not call an instructed rest command natural idle, and do not call separately epoched control/non-control trials continuous asynchronous data.
Unknown metadata stays unknown until a manifest or payload-level preflight is performed.

candidates.title: An Open Dataset for Wearable SSVEP-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
candidates.deployment_track: paired dry-to-wet hardware transfer and long-use degradation
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Not found in the checked inventory or its local discovery files; genuinely new to the reviewed local research assets.

mirrors.status: Paper-listed alternative endpoint; not fetched or independently verified in this pass.

participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: One approximately two-hour visit per participant; 10 consecutive blocks with wet electrodes and 10 with dry electrodes.
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Cue-guided 12-target SSVEP selection; 240 epochs per participant (12 targets x 10 blocks x 2 electrode types), 2.84 s each with 2 s stimulation.

labels_and_no_control.labels: Target index with stimulus frequency/phase mapping plus paired electrode type (wet/dry); impedance and comfort questionnaire information are described.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: No explicit idle or non-control class.

shift.enabled: Within-person wet-to-dry and dry-to-wet transfer; early-to-late block drift/fatigue; cross-participant generalization under a wearable 8-channel montage.
shift.pairing_strength: Strong: both electrode types were recorded for every participant under the same paradigm. Electrode order/counterbalancing must be checked before causal claims.

license_ethics.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0, displayed on the Figshare record.
license_ethics.ethics: Paper reports Tsinghua University Research Ethics Committee approval No. 20200020, Declaration of Helsinki compliance, signed informed consent, and consent-compatible sharing.
license_ethics.unknowns: The paper says participants were informed about non-commercial scientific research, while Figshare displays CC BY 4.0. Commercial-use interpretation should be reviewed before product use.

observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: 102 participant MAT files plus stimulation_information.pdf described in the paper.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: Archive link was visible; no archive or individual payload endpoint was fetched.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: Low-medium. Compact MAT release and explicit 5-D layout [channel, time, electrode, block, target]; adapter must preserve paired wet/dry identity and block order.
candidates.why_distinct: The cleanest large paired real-hardware shift among the candidates. It directly measures whether a model calibrated on gel/wet data survives a wearable dry-electrode deployment.
recommended_tests: Train wet, test dry and reverse, paired by participant.
Calibration curves versus number of dry blocks.
Accuracy/ITR and abstention drift from block 1 to block 10.
Eight-channel latency and memory budget under short windows.

evidence.supports: 102 participants, 8 channels, paired 10 wet and 10 dry blocks, total size, version, and CC BY 4.0.
Protocol, matrix layout, 250 Hz/2.84 s epochs, informed consent, ethics approval, and repository links.

candidates.title: Mobile BCI dataset of scalp- and ear-EEGs with ERP and SSVEP paradigms while standing, walking, and running
candidates.deployment_track: simultaneous scalp-to-ear transfer under locomotion and motion artifact
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Already catalogued, but not acquired or scored: ERP and SSVEP conversions appear separately in the prior EEGDash discovery snapshot as nm000201 and nm000125. Count them as one cohort.

mirrors.status: ERP BIDS conversion; prior local discovery metadata reports 24 participants, 113 recordings, 5.2 GB, CC BY 4.0.
SSVEP BIDS conversion; prior local discovery metadata reports 23 participants, 85 recordings, 1.3 GB, CC BY 4.0.

participants_sessions_channels_task.participants: Paper: 24 healthy participants for ERP; 23 for SSVEP. Running was optional, leaving 17 ERP and 16 SSVEP participants in the 2.0 m/s condition. The Figshare landing-page description says 18 subjects, creating a repository/paper discrepancy that requires manifest preflight.
participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: Per paper/BIDS naming: training plus standing, 0.8 m/s walking, 1.6 m/s walking, and optional 2.0 m/s running sessions; ERP and SSVEP tasks at each speed.
participants_sessions_channels_task.channels: Simultaneous 32-channel scalp EEG, 14-channel around-ear EEG, 4-channel EOG, and three 9-axis IMUs (forehead and both ankles).
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Visual ERP and SSVEP BCI tasks under four locomotion speeds.

labels_and_no_control.labels: Task/session/speed and modality are encoded in the BIDS-like file organization; ERP target/non-target and SSVEP stimulus-event labels are described by the paper.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: No dedicated intentional non-control class. Standing is a locomotion baseline, not BCI idle.

shift.enabled: Scalp-to-ear sensor transfer and standing-to-walking/running artifact shift, with IMU/EOG references recorded simultaneously.
shift.pairing_strength: Very strong: sensor modalities and motion sensors are simultaneous within participant/condition.

license_ethics.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 on the Figshare record and prior NEMAR discovery metadata.
license_ethics.ethics: Paper reports Korea University IRB approval KUIRB-2019-0194-01, written informed consent, and Declaration of Helsinki compliance.
license_ethics.unknowns: Confirm whether every participant/file advertised by the paper is present in the current Figshare version; the landing page's 18-subject wording conflicts with the paper's 24-person cohort.

observed_download_metadata.listing_status: Public Figshare listing verified; primary paper and prior NEMAR metadata verified.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_total_size: 8.34 GB on Figshare; NEMAR paradigm conversions total about 6.5 GB but are not an independent release/cohort.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: Paper describes subject/session/task EEG and IMU files; exact current file count was not exposed in the retrieved landing-page metadata.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: Archive button visible, but payload endpoints and manifest were not fetched.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: Medium-high. Synchronization is the scientific value and the adapter risk: preserve scalp/ear/EOG/IMU clocks, speed condition, optional-running missingness, and ERP versus SSVEP event semantics.
candidates.why_distinct: One cohort supplies two deployment shifts at once: wearable ear sensors and severe real movement contamination, with simultaneous scalp and motion references rather than synthetic noise.
recommended_tests: Train scalp/standing, test ear/standing; then ear/walking and ear/running.
Artifact robustness with and without EOG/IMU-assisted cleaning.
Speed-conditioned calibration and abstention.
ERP versus SSVEP degradation under the same motion regime.

evidence.supports: 24/23 participant counts, optional running counts, simultaneous channel/modalities, four speeds, task design, file naming, consent, and IRB.
Public listing, 8.34 GB, CC BY 4.0, and the conflicting 18-subject landing-page description.

candidates.title: Human EEG Dataset for Brain-Computer Interface and Meditation / Continuous sensorimotor rhythm based brain computer interface learning in a large population
candidates.deployment_track: longitudinal continual adaptation and continuous closed-loop control
candidates.priority: P0 if storage can be subsetted; otherwise P1
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Already catalogued, but not acquired or scored: Stieger2021 appears in the prior EEGDash discovery snapshot as NEMAR nm000339.

mirrors.status: BIDS/NEMAR mirror with subset-capable access and a published manifest URL; not fetched in this pass.
Metadata/git-annex mirror listed by NEMAR; no annexed data fetched.

participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: 598 session files; 7-11 sessions per participant, including a baseline eight weeks before the main training; approximately 60 minutes and 450 online trials per file.
participants_sessions_channels_task.channels: Original record describes 62 electrodes at 1000 Hz; the NEMAR discovery record exposes 60 EEG channels, so auxiliary/reference-channel handling must be reconciled.
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Online sensorimotor-rhythm BCI control in 1-D and 2-D cursor tasks using left hand, right hand, both hands, and rest imagery/control states; cursor X/Y trajectories are stored.

labels_and_no_control.labels: Trial metadata plus task/class, online success, target and continuous cursor positionX/positionY traces.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: A rest state exists, but it is an instructed BCI command/control state; it must not be treated as free natural idle.

shift.enabled: Day/session drift over up to 11 sessions, learning curves, continual adaptation, delayed baseline-to-training transfer, and continuous trajectory decoding.
shift.pairing_strength: Strong longitudinal within-participant design, but session counts vary and intervention/training history must be retained.

license_ethics.dataset_license: Original Figshare record displays CC BY 4.0. The NEMAR page/discovery metadata says CC-BY-NC-4.0; this mirror/source conflict must be resolved before redistribution or commercial use.
license_ethics.ethics: The primary paper describes de-identified healthy-volunteer data and informed consent/IRB-governed study procedures; the exact approval identifier was not recovered in this metadata pass.
license_ethics.unknowns: Authoritative license reconciliation and exact per-session channel typing remain open.

observed_download_metadata.listing_status: Original Figshare and NEMAR listings verified.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_total_size: 351.01 GB on Figshare; prior EEGDash/NEMAR snapshot 371.5 GB; current NEMAR page advertises 722.5 GB. Differences likely reflect version/conversion accounting and require manifest-level reconciliation.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: 598 subject-session MAT records in the original paper.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: NEMAR advertises stable manifest/direct-file and subject/session subset access; no manifest or payload URL was fetched.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: High overall, medium for a designed subset. Large per-session MAT structures, variable 7-11 session histories, trial cells, online feedback trajectories, and source/mirror metadata discrepancies require a careful adapter.
candidates.why_distinct: This is not merely multi-session classification: it contains hundreds of hours of online continuous cursor control and behavioral trajectories, allowing realistic continual-learning and closed-loop regression tests.
recommended_tests: Session 1 calibration, sequential evaluation through sessions 2-11 without future leakage.
Fixed model versus supervised and unsupervised continual adaptation.
Continuous cursor-velocity/position decoding and stability, not only trial accuracy.
Catastrophic forgetting and calibration-budget curves.

evidence.supports: 62 participants, 7-11 sessions, 62 electrodes, behavioral data, 351.01 GB, and CC BY 4.0.
598 sessions, more than 600 hours, 450 trials/session, MAT fields including cursor trajectories, and longitudinal/continuous-control purpose.
BIDS mirror, 60 EEG channels, subset/direct-manifest access, mirror size, and mirror-declared CC-BY-NC-4.0.

candidates.title: YSU: an EEG dataset for studying asynchronous SSVEP-BCI
candidates.deployment_track: intentional control versus multiple non-control states
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Not found in the checked inventory or local discovery files; genuinely new to the reviewed local research assets.

participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: All tasks were recorded within approximately three hours in one visit; CS and non-control tasks were collected in separate sessions/blocks, including two NS3 sessions.
participants_sessions_channels_task.channels: 63-channel actiCHamp EEG at 5000 Hz; Fz reference and FPz ground.
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Eight-frequency SSVEP control state (8, 9, 10.5, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 Hz) plus three non-control tasks.

labels_and_no_control.labels: CS has 96 trials and explicit target frequency; NS1 has 24 trials watching feedback with stimuli off; NS2 has 24 trials resting/gazing at a white wall; NS3 has 48 trials watching feedback while stimuli continue flickering.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: Yes, three intentionally different non-control conditions. Data are pre-epoched by state, not a single continuous stream.

shift.enabled: Control-state versus non-control detection, including the hard case where distractor stimuli continue flickering (NS3), and out-of-non-control-type generalization.
shift.pairing_strength: Within-participant state collection, but state blocks are separate and may permit block/session confounds.

license_ethics.dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 on the Figshare v3 record.
license_ethics.ethics: Paper reports Qinhuangdao First Hospital ethics committee approval and written informed consent.
license_ethics.unknowns: No approval identifier was visible in the retrieved article text.

observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: Per article: 24 subject folders, four MAT task files per subject, Subjects' Info.xlsx, and Channel Loc.xlsx; v3 specifically corrected the channel-location index/name mapping.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: Public archive listing verified; individual payload endpoints were not fetched.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: Medium. Simple MAT tensors but very high native sample rate and unequal epoch lengths; adapter must avoid learning task-file/block artifacts and must retain NS subtype.
candidates.why_distinct: It supplies real non-control EEG designed for asynchronous rejection rather than manufacturing idle windows from a synchronous benchmark.
recommended_tests: Train CS versus two NS types, hold out the third NS type as an unknown idle condition.
Frequency classification conditional on accepted control state.
Selective risk/false activation rate under NS3 continuous flicker.
Downsampling and short-window latency sweep.
candidates.limitations: The authors explicitly state that separately acquired, pre-epoched CS/NS data are unsuitable for evaluating a fully continuous online all-state system. Use this for gate/rejection benchmarking, not claims of continuous streaming deployment.

evidence.supports: 24 participants, task definitions, trial counts/tensors, 63 channels at 5000 Hz, ethics/consent, and the non-continuous limitation.
Public v3 record, 18.38 GB, CC BY 4.0, and corrected channel-location file history.

candidates.title: WAY-EEG-GAL: Multi-channel EEG Recordings During 3,936 Grasp and Lift Trials with Varying Weight and Friction
candidates.deployment_track: continuous kinematic and force regression from EEG with multimodal leakage controls
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Not found in the checked inventory or local discovery files; genuinely new to the reviewed local research assets.

participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: Exact independent visit/session count was not recovered; treat as unknown rather than assuming one session.
participants_sessions_channels_task.channels: 32-channel EEG plus EMG from five arm/hand muscles, 3-D hand/object position, and bilateral contact-plate force/torque.
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Naturalistic grasp-and-lift trials crossing three object weights (165, 330, 660 g) and three surface frictions (silk, suede, sandpaper). The collection title advertises 3,936 trials.

labels_and_no_control.labels: Continuous force/torque and kinematics plus event stages such as hand start, first digit touch, load phase, lift-off, replace, and release are the intended targets.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: No explicit BCI no-control state. Inter-trial periods may exist but must not be relabeled as intentional idle without payload/protocol verification.

shift.enabled: Continuous regression of force and 3-D movement, event forecasting, weight/friction condition shift, and robustness to natural executed-movement contamination.
shift.pairing_strength: Strong synchronous multimodal ground truth; strict EEG-only inputs are required to avoid EMG/force/kinematic leakage.

license_ethics.dataset_license: Unknown from the retrieved primary collection metadata; do not infer the dataset license from the paper's publication license.
license_ethics.ethics: Human-subject ethics/consent evidence was not recovered from the accessible metadata in this pass; check the primary paper before acquisition.
license_ethics.unknowns: Dataset license, exact current file count/bytes, and independent session count.

observed_download_metadata.listing_status: Public Springer Nature Figshare collection and DOI were verified through indexed metadata, but the collection page returned 403 to the browser tool.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: Unknown; no file manifest was exposed in the retrieved metadata.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: Public listing verified; file endpoints not verified.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: High. Multimodal clocks, variable-length executed-movement trials, event alignment, and leakage-safe feature selection must be audited. Small N also favors subject-held-out evaluation with uncertainty intervals.
candidates.why_distinct: It changes the benchmark target from trial class accuracy to time-resolved motor-output estimation with measured physical ground truth.
recommended_tests: EEG-only force and vertical-object-position regression under leave-one-subject-out splits.
Forecast first digit touch and lift-off before the event.
Train on two weights/frictions and test the held-out condition.
Explicit EMG leakage audit using low-pass and channel-exclusion controls.

evidence.supports: Public collection identity, DOI, advertised 3,936 trials, 32 EEG channels, EMG, 3-D position, and force/torque modalities.
Primary data descriptor and acquisition/task design.

candidates.title: Brain Invaders calibration-less P300-based BCI using dry EEG electrodes (bi2014a)
candidates.deployment_track: dry-electrode P300 calibration-free and low-channel deployment
candidates.prior_inventory_status: Already catalogued, but not acquired or scored: BrainInvaders2014a appears in the prior EEGDash discovery snapshot as NEMAR nm000244. BrainInvaders2014b is also in the older official-repository discovery file and is a separate wet collaborative cohort.

mirrors.status: BIDS/NEMAR conversion. Current/locally indexed metadata contains only 64 participants versus 71 at the canonical Zenodo source, so it is not verified as a complete mirror.
Author-linked manipulation code, not an independent data cohort.

participants_sessions_channels_task.participants: 71 at the canonical Zenodo source; NEMAR conversion exposes 64.
participants_sessions_channels_task.sessions: Up to three Brain Invaders game sessions per participant; nine game levels with repeated attempts are described.
participants_sessions_channels_task.channels: 16 active dry EEG electrodes, 512 Hz in the NEMAR discovery metadata.
participants_sessions_channels_task.task: Visual oddball P300 game with one target among 36 symbols; online adaptive/calibration-less feedback.

labels_and_no_control.labels: Target versus non-target flash events, game/session/level structure, and online interaction context.
labels_and_no_control.no_control_availability: No intentional idle/no-control state. Non-target flashes are still active task events and must not be treated as idle.

shift.kind: native within this cohort; cross-hardware comparison requires a second cohort
shift.enabled: Dry-electrode robustness, 16-channel latency/throughput, cross-session calibration-free transfer. A dry-to-wet test can be added against BI2015a/BI2014b only as an unpaired cross-cohort shift with protocol confounds.
shift.pairing_strength: No paired wet recording for the same participants.

license_ethics.dataset_license: NEMAR conversion declares CC-BY-4.0. The retrieved canonical Zenodo metadata did not expose a license field, so canonical-license confirmation remains required.
license_ethics.ethics: No explicit approval identifier or consent statement was recovered from the retrieved repository/paper metadata; verify before acquisition.
license_ethics.unknowns: Canonical license/ethics evidence and why seven canonical participants are absent from NEMAR.

observed_download_metadata.listing_status: Canonical Zenodo record and NEMAR listing verified.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_total_size: 3.4 GB at Zenodo; the prior NEMAR discovery snapshot reports about 1.0 GB for 64 converted participants.
observed_download_metadata.advertised_files: Zenodo page exposed Header.csv and a 3.4 GB total, but the complete individual-file index was not visible in retrieved metadata.
observed_download_metadata.file_endpoint_status: Public listings verified; payload endpoints not fetched.

candidates.acquisition_adapter_burden: Medium. MAT/CSV author tools exist, but the source/mirror participant mismatch, multiple attempts/levels, and online adaptive timing need audit before defining trials and leakage-safe splits.
candidates.why_distinct: A large real dry-electrode ERP cohort with online adaptive play is useful for low-channel/calibration-free validation, though it is weaker than the paired dry/wet SSVEP candidate for hardware-transfer claims.
recommended_tests: Session-one calibration versus zero-calibration transfer to later sessions.
Trial/level-aware false-positive and time-to-selection metrics.
16-channel streaming latency and confidence calibration.
Optional unpaired dry-to-wet stress test against BI2015a with explicit cohort/protocol caveats.

evidence.supports: Canonical DOI, 71 participants, 16 active dry electrodes, up to three sessions, task description, author code link, and 3.4 GB total.
BIDS mirror identity, 16 channels, mirror-declared CC-BY-4.0, and a smaller converted participant set.

strongest_three.reason: Large paired real dry/wet hardware shift with a small download and a simple adapter.
Simultaneous scalp/ear/EOG/IMU data across standing-to-running conditions supports genuine wearable and artifact tests.
Up to 11 sessions and continuous cursor trajectories enable continual adaptation and closed-loop regression rather than another trial classifier.

deferred_leads.name: Lee2019 / OpenBMI
deferred_leads.reason: High-quality 54-participant, two-session, three-paradigm data with EEG/EMG and resting recordings, but it adds less deployment novelty than the six selected tracks and is very large (the NEMAR SSVEP derivative alone advertises 73.2 GB). Keep as a multi-paradigm baseline, not a first expansion acquisition.

deferred_leads.name: Shin2017 EEG+NIRS
deferred_leads.reason: Useful multimodal/rest and physiological-artifact lead (29 participants, three days/six experiment records depending representation), but it requires acceptance terms in common adapters and is less direct than paired sensor/motion or continuous-control tracks.

deferred_leads.name: EESM19
deferred_leads.reason: Longitudinal ear/scalp sleep monitoring is promising for device transfer, but the prior inventory already flags the ear-EEG bundle as metadata-only with unresolved license and pairing provenance. The Lee2021 mobile dataset gives a cleaner simultaneous scalp/ear BCI test first.
